ISO Alternative to Carnation Instant Breakfast
I need an alternative to CIB - AND I need it to be low to no dairy (trace amounts is fine). I also need it to be POWDER, NOT LIQUID. Also no non-nutritive sweetener (stevia, etc.)

I know, I'm looking for a unicorn. 

(I also realize CIB contains a LOT of dairy - I'm just looking for an alternative that is quite similar!)
